source_caption_text:
He knew exactly what he was doing 😤🔥

Young Dolph’s “Talking To My Scale” has one of those moments that makes you run the song back immediately. The track is already riding on BandPlay’s dark production, but Dolph’s delivery is what really carries it. He sounds completely comfortable, barely forcing anything as he talks his usual shit.

Then the beat suddenly cuts out right in the middle of the verse. Dolph is still going, and instead of letting the moment pass, he uses that little pocket of silence to hit the line, “Naww I ain’t finished n****.” The timing is what makes it so funny and hard at the same time.

Then the beat comes right back in and Dolph keeps going like nothing happened. It’s such a simple production move, but the way he delivers that line makes the whole moment stand out. Young Dolph really knew how to make a few seconds of silence hit just as hard as the beat.
